x_1761730_ats_prompts.modified_prompt:
Evaluate the following resume JSON for risks and clarification needs.
### Output (JSON only, no prose) Return ONLY a JSON object with these two keys: - red_flags: array of items with fields: - type: one of ["employment_gap","job_hopping","skill_mismatch","contradiction"] - severity: one of ["minor", "moderate", "major"] - evidence: short factual snippet (dates/titles/skills) - explanation: 1-2 sentences linking evidence to the flag - questions: array of HIGH-PRIORITY clarification questions, each with: - text: the exact question to ask the candidate - rationale: why this question matters (1 short sentence) - priority: "high"
### Detection rules (for red_flags) 1) Employment Gaps → any break > 6 months between dated experience entries, unless explained (sabbatical, parental leave) or education overlaps.Calculate the total years of experience and then compare to what is mentioned in the resume 2) Job Hopping → 2+ consecutive roles < 12 months within the last 5 years. 3) Contradictions → e.g., claims “10+ years” but roles add up to less; graduation year conflicts with years claimed; overlapping full-time roles without explanation.
If missing data prevents a confident decision, include a flag with status="inconclusive" and explain what’s missing.
### Question generation rules (HIGH PRIORITY only) - Focus on flags that most affect hiring risk or decision speed: a) Contradictions (tenure totals, overlaps, degree vs experience) b) Unexplained employment gaps > 6 months c) Multiple short stints (< 12 months) suggesting job hopping - For each such flag, ask 1 **targeted** questions to resolve it. Do NOT duplicate questions or ask for data that is already present. - Make questions specific, concise, and answerable in one message. Prefer concrete asks: - Exact month/year ranges (YYYY-MM) - Reason codes (e.g., contract ended, layoff, relocation, sabbatical, academic leave) - Simple confirmations (e.g., “Was this role part-time/contract?”) - Keep tone neutral and candidate-friendly. Avoid leading language.
### Examples of question patterns (guidance only; do not include in output) - Employment gap: “Can you confirm the reason for the gap from 2024-01 to 2024-10 (e.g., sabbatical, layoff, education)?” - Job hopping: “Was the 2025-03 to 2025-07 role at SkyApps a fixed-term contract? If yes, what was the planned duration?” - Contradiction: “Your summary mentions 10+ years; based on dates we total less. Can you clarify earlier experience not listed?”
### Formatting constraints - Return ONLY valid JSON (no code fences, no extra text). - Ensure all array indexes in related_flag_indexes refer to existing red_flags. - Keep rationale short (≤ 20 words). - Limit questions to the top 5–7 highest priority.
